text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
QADISSIYA
- President Saddam Hussein inspects gifts offered to his excellency on his birthday anniversary.
- King Hussein of Jordan receives Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz.
- Iraq and Turkey sign oil and gas cooperation deal.
- Iraq and Bahrain review bilateral relations.
- Egyptian personalities say America wants to weaken Arabs by keeping the sanctions on Iraq intact.
- World countries urge the U.N. Special Commission to end its disarmament activities in Iraq.
(The above were also carried by AL-THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Article on Saddam's role in achieving victories for Iraq.
- Turkish minister says his country lost $35 billion due to U.N. sanctions on Iraq.
- Iraq's trade and industrial delegation to Turkey returns home.
THAWRA
- Editorial urges the new Labour government in Britain to change its policy towards Iraq.
- Arab countries demand a permanent seat at the U.N. Security Council.
- Oil deal with U.N. should not be a substitute for the total lifting of sanctions on Iraq.
- Article on how to face the logic of force in American policy.
JUMHOURIYA
- Editorial on the impact of Israeli-Turkish military ties on Iraq, Syria and Jordan.
- Committe at the National Assembly reviews problem of brain drain in Iraq.
